title: Precision Pilot Model
text: Represent precision pilot model, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Type of control} sets Aircraft dynamics control; {Pilot gain}, {Pilot time delay(s)}, {Equalizer lead constant}, {Equalizer lag constant}, {Lag constant for neuromuscular system}, {Undamped natural frequency neuromuscular system (rad/s)}, {Damping neuromuscular system} and {Controlled element undamped natural frequency (rad/s)}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Type of control
params.values: Aircraft dynamics control Proportional (default) | Rate or velocity | Acceleration | Second order

params.name: Controlled element undamped natural frequency (rad/s)
params.values: Controlled element undamped natural frequency 15 (default) | scalar
